content:
The City of Laredo recognized November as National Diabetes Awareness Month with a proclamation issued Friday morning at the Laredo Public Health Department.

Mayor Dr. Victor D. Treviño, joined by District 3 Council Member Melissa Cigarroa, issued the proclamation. Public Health Director Dr. Richard Chamberlain and Healthy Living Program Coordinator Homero Cantu also addressed attendees, emphasizing diabetes awareness, early detection, prevention, and healthy lifestyle choices.

Sources: City of Laredo.
